```python
def evaluate_gate(gate_type, inputs):
    if gate_type == 'AND':
        return 1 if all(inputs) else 0
    elif gate_type == 'OR':
        return 1 if any(inputs) else 0
    elif gate_type == 'NOT':
        return 0 if inputs[0] else 1
    elif gate_type == 'NAND':
        return 0 if all(inputs) else 1
    elif gate_type == 'NOR':
        return 0 if any(inputs) else 1
    elif gate_type == 'XOR':
        return 1 if sum(inputs) % 2 == 1 else 0
    elif gate_type == 'XNOR':
        return 1 if sum(inputs) % 2 == 0 else 0
    return 0
```
